'''Yannick Lapointe Quebec Championship (tournament report)''' is the tournament report [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech on 27 March 2000 about [[2000 Quebec Provincial Championship]].<ref name="tr-d397">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-27-quebec-championshipd397/ quebec-championship], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 27 March 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-03-27-quebec-championshipd397/ GitHub Pages].</ref> Yannick Lapointe won the 2000 Quebec championship (48 players) undefeated at 6–0 (12 (+113)) with a Throne Room / Cloud City drain deck and Hunt Down, ahead of Alex Klammrodt, Frédérick Gaudet-Péloquin and Raphael Asselin.

== Report info ==
* '''Author:''' [[Yannick Lapointe]] (byline: Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe)
* '''Published:''' 27 March 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Report title:''' ''Quebec Championship''
* '''Event:''' [[2000 Quebec Provincial Championship]]
* '''Event date:''' March 2000
* '''Site:''' Quebec, Canada
* '''Players:''' 48
* '''Finish:''' 1st
* '''Record:''' 6–0
* '''Points:''' 12 (+113)
* '''Light deck:''' [[2000 Quebec Provincial Championship Yannick Lapointe Qc Championship winner deck|Throne Room start with choke site, Cloud City drain sites with Pucumir Thryss, EPP beatdown crew, Off/On the Edge]]
* '''Dark deck:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down without duel, Imperial Arrest Order with Dark Business, character removal]]
